business_summary: Zhejiang Benli Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sales of pharmaceutical, pesticide, and new material intermediates in China and internationally. Its products include 2,4-Dichloro-5-fluorobenzoyl chloride, 2-(2,4-Dichloro-5-fluorobenzoyl)-3-cyclopropylamine ethyl acrylate, 1-Ethyl-7-(1-piperazinyl) -6-fluoro-1, 4-dihydro-4-oxo-3-quinolinecarboxylic acid hydrochloride, 2,4-Dichlorofluorobenzene, and Methyl 3-methoxyacrylate; and Ethyl N,N-dimethylaminoacrylate, 2,6-Dichlorofluorobenzene, and 3-(2-Ethylene Glycol Methyl Ether)-2-Methyl -4-Methanesulfonyl benzoic acid. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Linhai, China.
business_summary_ko: Zhejiang Benli Technology Co., Ltd.는 중국 및 국제적으로 의약품, 살충제 및 신소재 중간체의 연구, 개발, 생산 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 해당 제품에는 2,4-디클로로-5-플루오로벤조일 클로라이드, 2-(2,4-디클로로-5-플루오로벤조일)-3-사이클로프로필아민 에틸 아크릴레이트, 1-에틸-7-(1-피페라지닐)-6-플루오로-1,4-디하이드로-4-옥소-3-퀴놀린카르복실산 염산염, 2,4-디클로로플루오로벤젠 및 메틸 3-메톡시아크릴레이트가 포함됩니다. 및 에틸 N,N-디메틸아미노아크릴레이트, 2,6-디클로로플루오로벤젠, 및 3-(2-에틸렌 글리콜 메틸 에테르)-2-메틸-4-메탄술포닐 벤조산. 이 회사는 2011년에 설립되었으며 중국 린하이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
